author: ChatGPT
method: Individually authored kit objectives, item interactions, falsifications and matched-condition tests.

builds.name: Reference: Allied Sunlight pick control
builds.goal: Turn immobilizations into allied Sunlight damage
builds.summary: Turn immobilizations into allied Sunlight damage.
builds.hypothesis: Leona marks with abilities, but another allied champion must consume Sunlight. Q/E/R control creates that opportunity; W's defenses must be timed for retaliation. The support control measures allied follow-up, not fictional solo passive procs.
testPlan: Use a fixed allied attacker. Compare spaced marks with dumping all abilities before the ally attacks. Log consumed Sunlight marks, actual control time and ally survival.
Use three repeatable trials at the same level, ranks, gold spent, target HP/armor/MR and incoming damage. Record the short trade and ten-second fight separately.

Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. First Strike must be ready and initiated by you; Gathering Storm uses a fixed recorded game time. Do not grant full ramp, transformed items or takedown bonuses for free.
Repeat with a moving opponent and real interruption. Compare the reference route at the same cost; log missed actions and survival as well as damage.
failureConditions: The ally cannot reach or consume marks; the engage exposes the carry or W expires before retaliation.
Higher stationary-target damage is offset by lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: This objective is deliberately narrower than the entire champion kit; an ability ceiling is not proof of a strong overall build.
Farmed-role experiments require actual income and a viable early lane/clear. A support comparison keeps quest/vision responsibility.
Item/rune/pet/empowered-attack proc compatibility must be observed rather than inferred from a shared damage type.
buyOrder: Support quest and boots, then affordable ally protection; do not assume solo-lane income.
Compare a two-item checkpoint before the late six-slot illustration. Preserve movement boots unless a measured late replacement improves delivered damage.
coverageNotes: No numerical adapter exists for this champion. These individually authored hypotheses need manual game measurements; no global damage optimum or historical novelty is claimed.
Stored patch 26.20 source formulas are evidence, not a certified executable simulation. Resolve ambiguous tokens/stat formulas and current proc interactions before assigning numerical damage.

builds.summary: Create more landed Q stuns through real attack uptime.

testPlan: Compare normal attack → Q reset → attacks with Q-only at the same haste. Record Q intervals and time the opponent can act over ten seconds; repeat with kiting, attack-speed reduction and real incoming damage.
Use three repeatable trials at the same level, ranks, gold spent, target HP/armor/MR and incoming damage. Record the short trade and ten-second fight separately.

builds.goal: Deliver a complete AP Q/W/E/R burst with a center R hit
builds.summary: Deliver a complete AP Q/W/E/R burst with a center R hit.
builds.hypothesis: Solar Flare's AP ratio plus the other AP spell ratios supports a burst experiment, but the center stun, E connection and delayed W explosion must all land. Dusk supplies a separate empowered-attack packet. Leona cannot consume her own Sunlight, so solo damage excludes it.
testPlan: Measure center-R versus edge-R, E misses and W explosion misses. Separate solo Q/W/E/R damage from a fixed ally's Sunlight procs; isolate Dusk and Rocketbelt packets.
Use three repeatable trials at the same level, ranks, gold spent, target HP/armor/MR and incoming damage. Record the short trade and ten-second fight separately.

Repeat with a moving opponent and real interruption. Compare the reference route at the same cost; log missed actions and survival as well as damage.
failureConditions: One missed component removes the payoff; Leona dies before W explodes or cannot leave afterward.

builds.name: Experiment: Hybrid Daybreak brawler
builds.goal: Compare an attack-focused solo Leona with the Q-control loop
builds.summary: Compare an attack-focused solo Leona with the Q-control loop.
builds.hypothesis: Q's reset can deliver another real attack and item on-hit; W may buy a short melee window. AP strengthens Q/W/E/R and Nashor, while BotRK targets actual enemy health. Guinsoo/Dusk extra on-hits do not grant additional Q stuns or self-trigger Sunlight without evidence.
testPlan: Compare three seconds and ten seconds at matched gold against the Navori route. Count attacks, Q resets, actual proc packets and control time; test a moving enemy and include a separate ally trial for Sunlight.
Use three repeatable trials at the same level, ranks, gold spent, target HP/armor/MR and incoming damage. Record the short trade and ten-second fight separately.

Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. First Strike must be ready and initiated by you; Gathering Storm uses a fixed recorded game time. Do not grant full ramp, transformed items or takedown bonuses for free.
Repeat with a moving opponent and real interruption. Compare the reference route at the same cost; log missed actions and survival as well as damage.
failureConditions: No solo passive damage exists to rescue weak attack trades; items do not duplicate stuns and the opponent kites the attack window.
Higher stationary-target damage is offset by lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: This objective is deliberately narrower than the entire champion kit; an ability ceiling is not proof of a strong overall build.
